## Course overview

-   **Acquisition of Practical Bioinformatics Analysis Skills**

    ✅ What is RNA-seq data and how to analyze them

    ✅ Understanding fundamental statistics

    ✅ How to interpret and visualize the results

-   **Enhanced Data Convergence Capability for Translational Research**

    ✅ How to link omics data to clinical data

    ✅ How to explore public data of interest

    ✅ What would be promising targets

## Syllabus

| week | Contents                                                            |
|------|---------------------------------------------------------------------|
| W1   | Introduction to advanced bioinformatics & R Environment Setup       |
| W2   | Genome-wide Association Studies (GWAS) & Post-GWAS                  |
| W3   | Polygenic Risk Scores (PRS)                                         |
| W4   | Epigenomics I: DNA methylation                                      |
| W5   | Epigenomics II: Chromatin accessibility & 3D Genome                 |
| W6   | Metagenomics I: 16s rRNA-seq                                        |
| W7   | Metagenomics II: WMS                                                |
| W8   | Single-cell RNA-seq Fundamentals: Cell-type Specificity             |
| W9   | Advanced Single-cell Analysis: Trajectory & cell-cell communication |
| W10  | Spatial Transcriptomics                                             |
| W11  | Multi-omics Integration & GWAS Gene Prioritization                  |
| W12  | Network Analysis & Drug Repositioning (Clinical AI)                 |
| W13  | Data interpretation & visualization                                 |
| W14  | Rscript and vibe coding tips & Individual Project Design            |
| W15  | Final Project Presentation (Pitching the Hypothesis)                |

-   Part1: Intro (W1)

-   Part2: Clinical Genomics & Risk Prediction (W2-W3)

-   Part3: High-Resolution Omics (W4-W10)

-   Part4: Multi-omics & Target Discovery (W11-W12)

-   Part5: Capstone (W13-W15)

주의사항

-   W10 전날 밤에 Visium 데이터 집에서 받아오기

-   패키지 전체 설치는 30분 이상 걸리니 W1 수업 전에 미리

-   W11은 UCSC Xena 방법이 TCGAbiolinks보다 훨씬 빠름

**개인 노트북에서 제일 주의할 점**

| 위험도 | 주차              | 이유                     |
|--------|-------------------|--------------------------|
| ⚠⚠     | W10 Visium        | 2GB, H&E 이미지 포함     |
| ⚠⚠     | W11 TCGA          | 1GB, 서버 느림           |
| ⚠      | W3 1000G LD panel | 300MB, bigsnpr 전용 포맷 |
| ⚠      | W12 STRINGdb      | 500MB, 첫 실행 시 자동   |
